summary: Customer currently sends petroleum stream samples to a laboratory for water determination and wants to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process, with the analyzer outside the process area, to notice changes sooner. They ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.
